acceptance.given: A public entry is authored or exposed.

oracle.expected: The declaration explicitly specifies preflight behavior.
forbidden: A public entry has no preflight declaration.
Required preflight behavior is implicit or ambiguous.
oracle.observable: The public entry declaration contains an explicit preflight specification.

acceptance.then: The declaration includes an explicit, reviewable preflight specification.
acceptance.when: The declaration is inspected during package validation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a public-entry declaration whose preflight field is absent or ambiguous; validation must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require explicit preflight behavior in every public-entry declaration.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validation-only behavior; no persisted schema or state changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: A declaration lacking preflight becomes a validation failure.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator test accepts explicit preflight declarations and rejects absent or ambiguous ones.

acceptance.given: A public entry is invoked while a required dependency is absent.

oracle.expected: An explicit blocked, failed, or unmet-preflight outcome is emitted before dependent behavior continues.
forbidden: The entry continues as though the dependency were available.
The dependency check is bypassed or hidden.
oracle.observable: The invocation result or diagnostic records the unmet dependency and prevents dependent continuation.

acceptance.then: Execution is prevented from proceeding past the unmet dependency.
acceptance.when: Required-dependency handling is exercised with the dependency unavailable.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the dependency-unavailable case; the entry must fail or block before dependent behavior.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Block entry execution when a required dependency is absent and expose the unmet-preflight outcome.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Fail-closed dependency handling with no persisted state changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: An invocation with an absent dependency becomes explicitly blocked or failed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The dependency-unavailable selector observes an unmet-dependency outcome and no dependent continuation.

acceptance.given: A public entry encounters a missing legitimate child dependency.

oracle.expected: The entry reports the child as unmet and performs no implicit installation or provisioning.
forbidden: The public entry silently installs a missing child.
The dependency appears satisfied without explicit provisioning.
oracle.observable: The result or diagnostic identifies the missing child and the execution trace shows no implicit installation.

acceptance.then: The missing child remains explicit at the entry boundary without silent installation.
acceptance.when: Child-dependency handling is exercised with the child unavailable and boundary effects inspected.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the missing-child case; the entry must expose the unmet dependency without implicit installation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Surface missing child dependencies without silent installation or provisioning.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Dependency reporting remains fail-closed and does not mutate environment state.

slice_hint.state_transition: A missing child remains unmet and becomes an explicit diagnostic outcome.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selector observes an unmet-child diagnostic and no implicit installation action.
